parameters.name: tsanet_username
parameters.description: TSANet API username (email of your dedicated TSANet API user)

parameters.name: tsanet_password
parameters.description: TSANet API password. Stored as a secure setting. Avoid double-quote and backslash characters in this value (it is inserted server-side into a JSON login body).

parameters.name: field_id_token
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Token (Admin Center > Tickets > Fields)

parameters.name: field_id_tokens_multi
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Tokens Multi (optional)

parameters.name: field_id_status
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Status (Admin Center > Tickets > Fields)

parameters.name: field_id_partner
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Partner (Admin Center > Tickets > Fields)

parameters.name: field_id_respond_by
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Respond By (Admin Center > Tickets > Fields)

parameters.name: allowed_action_roles
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of Zendesk role names allowed to invoke TSANet actions (e.g. admin or a custom role name). Empty = all agents. Defense-in-depth only; the TSANet API is the real authorization boundary.

parameters.name: field_id_action
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Action (the dropdown that drives Accept/Reject/Info/Note). Required: the ZIS bundle references it, and the deploy screen will not upload without it.

parameters.name: field_id_action_text
parameters.description: Zendesk numeric Field ID for TSANet Action Text (free-text body for Add Note). Required: the ZIS bundle references it, and the deploy screen will not upload without it.

parameters.name: tsanet_connection_name
parameters.description: Name of the ZIS OAuth connection used for TSANet API calls. Leave as tsanet_oauth unless your instance registered it under a different name.

parameters.name: tsanet_engineer_email
parameters.description: Email used as engineerEmail on TSANet Accept calls. Must be on your member company's registered domain. Required: the ZIS bundle's Accept action carries it, and the deploy screen will not upload without it.
